questions.q: Why does the scaffolding guide recommend committing a lockfile?
options: So every machine builds the same thing
questions.why: Committing a lockfile ensures every machine builds the same thing, making the project reproducible.

questions.q: What is the target time for a new developer to clone, install, and run the project?
options: It doesn't matter at this stage
questions.why: The guide states a new developer should be able to clone, install, and run in under ten minutes as a sign the stage is complete.

questions.q: What does a 'vertical slice' refer to in the scaffolding stage?
options: One feature working end to end through UI, API, and database
questions.why: A vertical slice means one feature works end to end — UI to API to database.
